entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return. Let's just get this done.
Certainly. I can help with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF8675309. Look, is this going to take a long time? I just need a yes or no on whether I can return this jersey.
I understand you're busy. Let me pull that up for you right now... Okay, I see the order. It was for the Aero-Tech jersey, delivered about 55 days ago. Can I ask what the issue is?
It's the wrong size. It's way too tight and I need to do an exchange or get a refund.
That's no problem at all. Your jersey falls under our standard 90-day return policy, so you are well within the window. I can process that for you immediately.
Good. So what do I do?

I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. Since you're one of our VIP customers, I can also process an immediate exchange with complimentary express shipping so you don't have to wait. Would you like the next size up?
Yes, the exchange with express shipping. That works. Thank you.
Excellent. I've just processed that for you. You'll receive a separate confirmation email for the new order shortly. Is there anything else I can help with?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
